cleanableHint: What the next cleanup would remove, with files older than {days} days.

app_logs.label: App logs
app_logs.description: Puppeteer's own log, one file per day. Days older than the auto-clean age are removed; today's file never is.

pastes.label: Pastes saved as files
pastes.description: Long pastes kept as files for a Session. They go with their Session; only those whose Session is gone are cleaned.

worktrees.label: Worker worktrees
worktrees.description: Copies of a Project a Conductor worker ran in. Removed only when the worker finished long ago and everything it did is committed and merged.

snapshots.label: Rewind snapshots
snapshots.description: File snapshots taken before each turn, for Rewind. Dropped after the auto-clean age (30 days when it is off).

trash.label: In the Trash
trash.description: Logs and transcripts of Sessions and Projects in the Trash (already counted above). Purged after they have been in the Trash longer than the auto-clean age.

deleted_accounts.label: Deleted Claude accounts
deleted_accounts.description: Folders of Claude accounts that were removed. Kept while a Session's transcript is still inside.

sidecar_junk.label: Model check and translation transcripts
sidecar_junk.description: Transcripts the model check and translation left behind (already counted in Claude CLI sessions). They are never resumed.

account_other.label: Claude account settings and caches
account_other.description: Everything in the managed Claude accounts except transcripts: plugins, backups, shell snapshots, caches. Shown only.

codex_accounts.label: Codex accounts
codex_accounts.description: Managed Codex account folders. Shown only.

database.label: Database
database.description: Puppeteer's database. Compact it to give back the space of deleted rows.

dialog.title: Clean up storage
dialog.intro: These files are older than {days} days and nothing uses them any more. Nothing is deleted until you confirm.
dialog.offNote: Auto-clean is off, so this uses {days} days.
dialog.keptWorktrees: {n} worktree(s) with unfinished work (uncommitted or not merged) stay. Merge or discard that work to free {size}.
dialog.estimate: Sizes in the Trash are estimates.
dialog.empty: Nothing to clean up right now.

busy: A cleanup is already running. Try again when it finishes.
doneWithErrors: Cleaned up {size} ({files} files). {errors} item(s) could not be removed; the app log names them.
previewFailed: Could not look for old files: {error}

compactConfirm.title: Compact database
compactConfirm.message: Rewrite the database to give back the space of deleted rows? It can take a few seconds and needs free disk space about the size of the database.

compactRunsActive: A Session is running. Stop it, then compact the database.
compactDbBusy: Another process is using the database. Try again in a moment.

settings.title: Storage
settings.daysHint: Old logs, pastes, finished worktrees, Rewind snapshots, deleted accounts, model-check transcripts and the Trash are cleaned automatically once a day. 0 turns auto-clean off (snapshots then keep 30 days). Sessions in History are never cleaned. Applies to this machine only.
settings.invalid: Use 0 (off) or a number from 7 to 3650. Any other value uses the default, 30 days.
settings.off: Auto-clean is off (0 here, or switched off in Features). Clean now on the Stats page still works.
settings.openStats: See what uses space on the Stats page
